name: ai-skills
description: Simon's curated collection of AI agent skills, packaged as an installable Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: ai-skills
plugins.description: Curated engineering skills: clean-code (Uncle Bob's Clean Code principles), code-commenting (when and how to comment), codebase-design (deep modules, seams, interface vocabulary), TDD (red-green-refactor, behavior-focused tests), git conventions, devcontainer-setup (sandbox the agent before development), lensed-review (parallel multi-lens code audit), and waitwhat (re-pitch what did not land).
